SUMMARY
Marketing graduate with one year of agency experience supporting social media, email and reporting for small business clients. Organized, dependable and comfortable juggling several accounts at once.

EXPERIENCE
Fieldstone Creative, Lexington, KY
Marketing Coordinator, September 2025 - Present
- Schedule social media posts for eight client accounts across Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn using the agency's scheduling tool
- Draft monthly performance reports for clients using analytics dashboards and templates
- Assist account managers with preparing client meeting agendas and taking notes
- Write first drafts of email newsletters and blog posts for review by the content lead
- Coordinate with the design team on image requests and keep the shared asset folder organized
- Monitor client inboxes and social comments and flag items for the account manager
- Update the agency's content calendar each week and send reminders to clients for approvals
- Help set up email campaigns in Mailchimp, including list imports and basic subject line tests
- Attend weekly client status calls and circulate the follow-up notes

Eastern Kentucky University Athletics, Richmond, KY
Marketing Intern, January 2025 - May 2025
- Helped run in-game promotions at basketball and baseball home games
- Posted game-day content to the department's social media accounts
- Assisted with set-up and tear-down for fan events and giveaways
- Compiled attendance figures into a weekly spreadsheet for the marketing director
- Helped the ticket office with group sales calls during the spring season

Campus Bookstore, Richmond, KY
Sales Associate (part-time), August 2022 - December 2024
- Assisted students with textbook orders and returns during rush periods
- Restocked shelves and handled the register
- Helped train two new part-time associates

EDUCATION
Eastern Kentucky University, Richmond, KY
Bachelor of Business Administration in Marketing, May 2025
GPA: 3.2/4.0
Relevant coursework: Consumer Behavior, Digital Marketing, Marketing Research, Integrated Marketing Communications
Senior project: a social media plan for a local coffee roaster (team of 4)

SKILLS
Social media scheduling (Hootsuite, Meta Business Suite), Canva, Mailchimp, Google Analytics (basic), Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, copywriting, customer service

ACTIVITIES
American Marketing Association, EKU chapter, member (2023 - 2025)
Intramural volleyball
Volunteer, Lexington Humane Society adoption events (photography and social posts), 2026 - Present
